## Kindle Custom Screensaver v0.6.0

This release adds shuffle and sequential image modes, shows images in color on the Kindle Colorsoft, and keeps images upright when the Kindle sleeps in landscape. It includes the fixes previously available in the `landscape-fix-1` and `colorsoft-fix-1` testing prereleases.

### Changes

* The **Custom Screensaver** Scriptlet now cycles through three modes, one per run: shuffle (a random image each time, never the same one twice in a row), sequential (images in filename order), and off
* Shows screensaver images in color on the Kindle Colorsoft instead of grayscale
* Shows screensaver images in portrait when the Kindle goes to sleep while reading in landscape, instead of stretching them
* Documents how to add the KPM repository from kterm when `;kpm add-repo` does nothing in the Kindle search bar

### Installation and updates

Available through KPM or the `custom-screensaver-0.6.0-kindlehf.zip` release package.

For ZIP updates, disable the custom screensaver before replacing the runtime files, then re-enable it using the **Custom Screensaver** Scriptlet. Your screensaver images remain untouched. After updating, the custom screensaver starts in shuffle mode; run the Scriptlet until it shows "turned off" to disable it.

Users of the `landscape-fix-1` or `colorsoft-fix-1` testing prereleases can update to this stable release. See the README for full installation and update instructions.
